notes.heading: Frame
notes.text: The mesh sits in the Arm Body's assembly frame (z 86–98). The shank stands in a K1 slot of the Arm Body and in the Pivot Stator Holder's ear slot.

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, so it should hide the mesh entirely. The revised render draws no fits yet; they wait for the arm body's assembly. The dimensions are in 200-003_StatorBalancer.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
